Game Overview

In Monster Escape, the core idea is straightforward: escape the shadowy dungeon in Monster Escape, an inventive puzzle adventure testing your strategy and reflexes across 60 levels. Rotate the world, dodge dynamic traps, and collect keys to freedom. Uncover hidden paths and master every challenge for a gripping and mysterious experience. Can you outsmart the dungeon?
